rules.description: Current process is running with UID 0.
rules.exploit: Use the current root context to perform privileged operations available to the process.

rules.description: Current user belongs to the sudo group and may have elevated administrative privileges.
rules.exploit: Run an allowed command through sudo and use the resulting privileged execution to escalate.

rules.description: Current user belongs to the wheel group, commonly used to grant administrative privileges.
rules.exploit: Use the administrative privileges granted to wheel members to execute an allowed command with elevated privileges.

rules.description: Current user belongs to the docker group and may control the Docker daemon.
rules.exploit: Use Docker daemon access to create a privileged container with access to the host filesystem and obtain host-level root execution.

rules.description: Current user belongs to the lxd group and may control the LXD daemon.
rules.exploit: Use LXD to create or launch a privileged container with access to the host filesystem and obtain host-level root execution.

rules.description: Current user belongs to the lxc group, which may provide access to privileged LXC management operations.
rules.exploit: Use available LXC management privileges to create or access a privileged container and attempt to obtain host-level access.

rules.description: Current user belongs to the adm group, which commonly provides access to system logs and administrative information.
rules.exploit: Read accessible system logs and search them for credentials, secrets, or other information that can be used for privilege escalation.

rules.description: Current user belongs to the disk group and may have direct access to block devices.
rules.exploit: Use permitted block-device access to read or modify protected filesystem data and obtain sensitive credentials or privileged configuration.

rules.description: Current user belongs to the shadow group and may be able to read password hashes.
rules.exploit: Read password hashes from /etc/shadow and attempt offline password recovery against accounts with reusable credentials.
